profile.headline: Modeling Simulation & Analytics | Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Scrum Master and Software Engineer for Modeling and Simulation projects within my team. 

I have worked in industries ranging from automation engineering, defense and space, corporate insurance, and private equity and venture capital. I have been a developer, business intelligence analyst, and software engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Northrop Grumman is a global defense and space company with 87,951 employees and diverse specialties.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
Greenspring Associates, founded in 2000, is a leading global venture investment firm that provides commingled fund and customized partnership capabilities to a diverse group of institutions and individuals in North America, Asia, Europe and Australia.

Currently, managing approximately $4.1 billion of committed capital, its dedicated investment team combines broad venture fund and direct investment expertise.
